item.title: By: Melvin Didyk
item.dc:creator: Melvin Didyk
item.description: Unintended consequences in life reflects our experiences, limited knowledge and what makes us human. Underlying our unintentional actions are subtle and important “action” adjusters too including “mistakes”, “accidents”, “inadvertence” and other events of causal deviance. By understanding these important differences in action - based on our intentions - we gain more insight intentional human behavior. See “Intentional Action and their Adjusters: a Causal Theory of Action Revisited”
